serviceName eq 'Azure App Service' and priceType eq 'Consumption'

knownUnavailable.reason: AWS Batch carries no separate service charge; users pay only for underlying EC2/Fargate compute and EBS storage.
AWS Elastic Beanstalk control plane is free; billing applies to underlying EC2 instances, RDS, S3, and load balancers.
Azure Batch orchestration has no standalone Retail Prices meter; users pay only for underlying VMs and Storage.
Azure Communication Services Email meters are not exposed under a standalone serviceName in the Azure Retail Prices API.
Google Cloud Batch carries no separate orchestration charge; users pay only for underlying Compute Engine VMs and Persistent Disks.
OCI Batch orchestration (partNumber B112107) carries a $0 service rate in the Cost Estimator API; underlying Compute and Storage are billed separately.
OCI Vault Secrets have no separate SKU in the Cost Estimator API; secret storage sits within OCI Vault free allowance or Private Vault partitions.
OCI Data Science model deployments bill as underlying Compute VM OCPU and RAM shapes without a separate orchestration meter in the Cost Estimator API.
